claims.claim_text: Number of Pedestrians: An integer number of pedestrians to be spawned in the city.
claims.normalized_text: Number of pedestrians is specified as an integer to be spawned in the city.

claims.claim_text: Weather Id: An index of the weather/lighting presets to use. The following are currently supported: Clear Midday, Clear Sunset, Cloudy Midday, Cloudy Sunset, Soft Rain Midday, Soft Rain Sunset, Medium Rain Midday, Cloudy After Rain Midday, Cloudy After Rain Sunset, Medium Rain Sunset, Hard Rain Midday, Hard Rain Sunset, After Rain Noon, After Rain Sunset.
claims.normalized_text: Weather Id is an index selecting among multiple weather and lighting presets including Clear Midday, Clear Sunset, Cloudy Midday, Cloudy Sunset, Soft Rain Midday, Soft Rain Sunset, Medium Rain Midday, Cloudy After Rain Midday, Cloudy After Rain Sunset, Medium Rain Sunset, Hard Rain Midday, Hard Rain Sunset, After Rain Noon, and After Rain Sunset.

claims.claim_text: Seed Vehicles/Pedestrians: A seed that controls how non-player vehicles and pedestrians are spawned. It is possible to have the same vehicle/pedestrian behavior by setting the same seed.
claims.normalized_text: A seed controls spawning of non-player vehicles and pedestrians, enabling reproducible behavior by using the same seed.

claims.claim_text: Set of Cameras: A set of cameras with specific parameters such as position, orientation, field of view, resolution and camera type. Available camera types include an optical RGB camera, and pseudo-cameras that provide ground-truth depth and semantic segmentation.
claims.normalized_text: The system includes a set of cameras with configurable parameters and types including optical RGB and pseudo-cameras for ground-truth depth and semantic segmentation.
